sections.presenting_complaint: Central chest pain starting at about 11:00 while gardening.
sections.history: Heavy central chest pain radiating to the left arm, lasting about 30 minutes; ongoing at 3/10. Associated sweating and mild breathlessness; no nausea. No previous similar episodes or known cardiac disease. Hypertension. Smoker, 20 per day. Father had a myocardial infarction at 60. Aspirin 300 mg and GTN given by ambulance crew.
sections.medications_allergies: Amlodipine 5 mg once daily. No known drug allergies.
sections.examination: HR 88 regular, BP 152/90, SpO2 97% on air. Heart sounds normal. Chest clear. No peripheral oedema. ECG: sinus rhythm, no ST segment changes.
sections.plan: Serial high-sensitivity troponin. Fondaparinux 25 mg subcutaneously once daily. GTN spray as required. Admit under cardiology; likely coronary angiography. Repeat ECG with any further pain.
sections.safety_netting: Asked to report recurrent or worsening pain to nursing staff immediately.
